title: A Quantum Multi-Programming Framework to Maximize Quantum Resources for the LUCJ Ansatz
summary: In the context of quantum computing, efficient resource management is crucial for optimizing throughput on cloud-based platforms and maximizing hardware utilization. In the present work, we propose an approach to tackle quantum chemistry problems via quantum multi-programming of the Local Unitary Cluster Jastrow (LUCJ) ansätze. The ground-state energy of the molecular system is obtained via Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), further refined by its extended version (ext-SQD).
